name: LULA
rootCause: The LULA token on BSC was exploited when attackers abused the privileged recycle() function in its contract, combined with an approximately $237 million flash loan to manipulate PancakeSwap V2 liquidity pool reserves, resulting in a loss of about $578,100.

descriptions.text: The LULA token on BSC was exploited when attackers abused the privileged recycle() function in its contract, combined with an approximately $237 million flash loan to manipulate PancakeSwap V2 liquidity pool reserves, resulting in a loss of about $578,100.

LULA on BNB Chain lost about $578,000 on 2026-07-28 after an attacker abused a privileged recycle() path that could transfer tokens directly out of a PancakeSwap V2 pair and immediately resynchronize reserves with sync(). The attacker combined the reserve rewrite primitive with large flash-loan-backed swaps to distort the LULA/USDT pool price and extract USDT. Public incident analyses and the checked exploit transaction indicate that LULA exposed an attacker-reachable path to a privileged recycle() function.
